reviewer: Codex independent subagent (inherited configured model and effort; exact deployment metadata not exposed)
scope: Approved scans5–24 source words only; no pointing questions, no new image readings, no project edits. Independent encoding/order/export review remains necessary for final implementation.
guideline_decisions: Keep place-specific speaker directions, minyan gates, seasonal context declarations in service occurrences; reusable prayer words carry only genuine text-internal variants.

Use condition rubric inside j:conditional for when; description after opening gate for speaker/name/how; documentary instructions that direct unprinted text remain directives. Expansion changes them to descriptions before supplied text.
Use type=marked for printed parenthetical wording variants. Preserve unknown alternatives rather than choosing defaults without evidence.

Expanded structural sequence uses canonical URNs and explicit priorities with volume-two witnesses first. Documentary uses edition-qualified witnesses; dependencies unprinted in this volume must be credited as external compatible witnesses.

Bible quotation seg/@source alone is insufficient: retain bounded chapter/verse or verse-part milestones and explicit same-unit closing milestones before prose or other prayers. Do not turn every biblical allusion into a complete biblical quotation.

conditions.decision: Apply minyan=false to only the three prayer words; יחיד אומר is condition rubric; preserve absent English counterpart. Context belongs to Shema occurrence.

Gate communal Barekhu with minyan=true in expanded spine; keep reader, congregation and combined Hebrew source role rubrics with their own occurrences. Preserve Hebrew/English role wording differences rather than silently harmonizing them.

Minyan=true gates reader instruction/description, biblical preface and half Kaddish occurrence together. Keep the printed psalm81:4–5 before the Reader direction. The printed חזן begins actual Kaddish; do not insert that role into canonical prayer words.

Retain printed לעלא ולעלא מן כל as fixed Rosh Hashanah witness. Do not replace with Birnbaum wording or discard whole Kaddish on non-Ten-Days settings. When externally supplying a generic conditional Kaddish for this occurrence, locally declare aseret-ymei-tshuva=true and close it. Birnbaum generic insertion uses the exact registered expression listed.

Condition covers entire Vatodienu paragraph only, after Attah Vechartanu and before Vatitten Lanu. Close before Vatitten Lanu; both language rubrics belong to this condition. No Shabbat replacement text is printed for second day.

Printed unpointed מלכנו is independently optional wording, not a calendar or speaker instruction. Reuse registered named variant, type=marked, unknown by default, include only that word in gate; keep its unpointed source form. English lacks it and stays absent. No human semantic question is required: existing first-day exact equivalent establishes encoding, while the historical reason for parentheses need not be asserted.

Silent Amidah: local recitation/silent=true, repetition=false; service-time/maariv=true with other services false. No repetition, Kedushah, Shabbat inserts, Mashiv haruach, or Ten Days additions beyond this printed source are to be imported.

Documentary retains directive only. Expanded transcludes complete compatible Kaddish after Elohai Netzor and Yehi Ratzon, inside minyan gate; reader description belongs here. Prefer first-day Marmorstein/Heidenheim full-Kaddish witness with its credits and exact source record; verify canonical identity resolves complete text, seasonal double wording, and no unrelated preface is accidentally included.

Order: Savri (Hebrew only), wine blessing, RH Kiddush, [fire blessing and Qodesh-leQodesh Havdalah iff Motzaei Shabbat], Shehecheyanu. Close condition before Shehecheyanu. No besamim or Vayekhullu printed and none should be imported. This is festival Havdalah inside Kiddush, so synagogue-havdalah is inapplicable. Kiddush is not itself minyan-dependent.

Aleinu follows Kiddush unconditionally within service. No English Aleinu printed. Documentary preserves קדיש יתום. יגדל. directive. Expansion follows with compatible external Kaddish Yatom then Yigdal; credits/provenance expose their origin without claiming printed volume-two English.

Follow existing expanded first-night convention: minyan=true AND service-context/mourners-present=true; keep source wording/name as description inside gate. Minyan is required; whether the community appoints a nonmourner in the absence of mourners is not specified by this source. Preserve undecided condition, rather than silently inventing custom. No user question needed to encode this acknowledged reader/community choice.
Yigdal follows mourner Kaddish but remains outside minyan/mourners gate. It is not lost when no minyan or mourners exist. Do not add other familiar conclusion prayers.

settings.documentary: electronic.day=none (No particular day), no Gregorian date injected; preserve all printed conditional alternatives. Book context may declare RH day2 and Maariv locally without deciding motzaei-shabbat or minyan. Do not bake in false minyan=true or weekday merely to remove brackets.
settings.expanded: Outer day-two Maariv gate = ALL holiday/rosh-hashana numeric2 and service-time/maariv=true. Inside gate declare those exact values and other services=false, aseret-ymei-tshuva=true. Close all declarations at end. Leave Motzaei Shabbat unresolved in undated output. Day2 is never Shabbat in the fixed calendar; do not use day1 Shabbat options to generate day2.
settings.calendar_evidence: Derived with installed pyluach HebrewDate(year,7,2); compute.py effective Hebrew day changes at nightfall, Motzaei Shabbat continues until Sunday dawn. Use real coordinates/timezone/time (e.g. Jerusalem or New York) for sunset/twilight tests; do not fake civil date to select variant.
required_matrix: undated/unknown minyan and Motzaei Shabbat retains instructions/options
minyan true excludes El Melekh Neeman; false includes it and excludes communal Kaddish/Barekhu
Motzaei Shabbat true includes Vatodienu and fire+Havdalah with no undecided delimiter; false excludes all three; Shehecheyanu remains
malkenu unknown retains marked choice; true includes word; false excludes it
mourners false removes only Yatom; Yigdal and Aleinu remain
actual day2 holiday selects second-day structural occurrence and excludes day1; unrelated date does not show date-inappropriate service

quotation_bounds.rule: Separate each real verse/partial verse; repetitions maintain independent occurrence IDs; do not let Psalm chapter scope span intervening texts.
Barukh Shem lies outside Deut6 scripture scope; emet joining blessing after Num15:41 is not part of verse41.
Terminate chapter/verse before reader rubric, next biblical book, and Kaddish.
Quotation starts after introductory kakatuv wording; ends before following prayer words/blessing.

quotation_bounds.rule: The surrounding liturgical paragraph is not Psalm103:19 in full; use source attribution for its adapted allusions.
Keep references bounded at exact quote ends; Oseh Shalom is liturgical adaptation/allusion to Job25:2, not a complete exact verse.

Zechariah14:9 והיה יי למלך through ושמו אחד
quotation_bounds.rule: Begin after introductory ככתוב/ונאמר, close chapter+verse before next introduction or prayer end. Isaiah45:23 תכרע כל ברך תשבע כל לשון is adapted quotation/allusion, not a full verse witness.

unresolved_semantics.resolution: Not required to resolve for faithful optional-word encoding; use existing registered malkenu choice.

unresolved_semantics.item: Nonmourner saying Kaddish Yatom if no mourners
unresolved_semantics.resolution: Source does not settle community custom; existing minyan+mourners condition retains reader choice. Do not impose alternative convention.

unresolved_semantics.item: Source-appropriate external full Kaddish/Yatom/Yigdal witness selection
unresolved_semantics.resolution: Encoding implementation must verify actual chosen source and exact extent, credits and translation provenance. First-day volume is strongest compatible candidate, not permission to overwrite its wording.

limitations: This audit settles expression/placement/order semantics from already approved source records and existing conventions. It does not certify future generated XML/PDF/HTML or reread source pointing. No new source question is proposed.
